vetSays.line: 🛡️ Scott, the person in their 50s, Willow and Ornella met them at the door — 4 put down. Scott, the person in their 50s, Willow, Ornella are hurt.
🛡️ Scott, Arjun and Willow met them at the door — 3 put down. Arjun, Willow are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Scott, Arjun, Ornella and Adaeze met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Scott, Arjun, Adaeze are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Big-Eyes!
🛡️ Scott, Arjun, Willow, Ornella and Chantal met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Arjun, Willow, Ornella, Chantal are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ornella just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Arjun just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Scott, Arjun and Adaeze met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Scott, Arjun, Adaeze are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Scott just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Scott, Arjun, Adaeze, Raj and Vasyl met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Scott, Arjun, Adaeze are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Nino, Sumaya and Dola met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Nino, Sumaya, Dola are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sumaya just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Nino met them at the door — 1 put down. Nino is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Adaeze was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Maeve taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Maeve passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Raj — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Raj chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
Maeve: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
